title: Conditional Vendi Score: Prompt-Aware Diversity Evaluation for Generative AI Models and LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2411.02817v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative models guided by text prompts are widely evaluated for fidelity and prompt alignment, yet their ability to produce diverse outputs remains underexplored. Existing diversity metrics such as Vendi and RKE, which are based on the von Neumann and R\'enyi entropies of kernel matrices, were developed for unconditional models and cannot distinguish prompt-induced from model-induced variability. We address this gap by introducing \textit{Conditional-Vendi} and \textit{Conditional-RKE}, diversity measures derived from the conditional entropy of positive semidefinite matrices. These scores isolate model-induced diversity in prompt-guided generation, with Conditional-RKE enjoying an $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ convergence rate. For Conditional-Vendi, we introduce a truncated-spectrum approximation that yields scalable and consistent estimates. translated_title: 条件Vendi分数：面向生成式AI模型与大语言模型的提示感知多样性评估
translated_abstract: 由文本提示引导的生成式模型在保真度和提示对齐方面已被广泛评估，但其产生多样化输出的能力仍未得到充分研究。现有的多样性指标（如基于核矩阵的冯·诺依曼熵和Rényi熵的Vendi与RKE）是为无条件模型设计的，无法区分由提示引起的变异与模型自身引起的变异。我们通过引入条件Vendi（Conditional-Vendi）和条件RKE（Conditional-RKE）来填补这一空白，这两种多样性度量源自半正定矩阵的条件熵。这些分数能够在提示引导的生成中分离出由模型引起的多样性，其中条件RKE具有O(1/√n)的收敛速率。对于条件Vendi，我们提出了一种截断谱近似方法，可提供可扩展且一致的估计。在文本到图像、图像描述生成以及大语言模型任务上的实验表明，条件分数能够……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了基于条件熵的条件Vendi和条件RKE两种新度量方法，能够在提示引导的生成任务中分离出模型自身引起的多样性，为生成式AI模型和大语言模型提供了提示感知的多样性评估工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Conditional-Vendi and Conditional-RKE, novel diversity metrics based on conditional entropy that isolate model-induced diversity in prompt-guided generation, enabling prompt-aware diversity evaluation for generative AI models and LLMs.
